senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; לָבַב; cmp. קֶרֶב a. קָרַב) [innermost,] heart, bosom; thought, inclination, mind &c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 1:5">Sot. I, 5</cite> <he>היה לִבָּהּ נאה</he> if her bosom was handsome (inciting the senses).
<cite ref="Shevuot 26a:18">Shebu. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>לִבְּךָ אנסך</he> thy heart has carried thee away against thy will, i.e. you were under the impression that you told the truth.
<cite ref="Niddah 3b:28">Nidd. 3ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>לִבּוֹ נוקפו</he>, v. <cite ref="N01233"><he>נָקַף</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Menachot 79b:9">Men. 79ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>לב ב״ד מתנה עליהן</he> the authorities (in receiving materials for offerings) accept them with a condition at heart (that they may dispose at their discretion of what has not been used for sacrifices).—<he>לבו גס</he>, v. <cite ref="C00445"><he>גּוּס</he> I</cite>.—
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX, 1</cite> <he>לבו עליו</he> his heart is against him, he bears him a grudge.—

<cite ref="Zevachim 21a:1">Zeb. 21ᵃ</cite> <he>להוציא מִלִּבָּן של צדוקים</he> to remove (the false opinion) out of the heart of the Sadducees, i.e. to demonstrate, by practice, the rejection of their opinion; <cite ref="Chagigah 23a">Ḥag. 23ᵃ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>מפני הצדוקים</he>); <cite ref="Yoma 2a">Yoma 2ᵃ</cite> (Ms. M. <he>מפני הצ׳</he>, v.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87:5">Gen. R. s. 87</cite>, end (in a gloss) <he>להוציאה מלבן של הבריות</he> in order to remove (the bad opinion about) her out of the hearts of men, i.e. to save her reputation.—
<cite ref="Nedarim 20b">Ned. 20ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C01315"><he>גָּרוּשׁ</he></cite>; a. v. fr.—Trnsf.

<cite ref="Megillah 14a:17">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 45b:9">Succ. 45ᵇ</cite> as the palm-tree <he>אין לו אלא לב אחד וכ׳</he> has only one ‘heart’ (sap-cells only in the stem but none in the branches), so has Israel one heart directed to his Father &c.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:11">Lev. R. s. 30</cite>, end <he>לולב לִבָּהּ של וכ׳</he> a Lulab which is the central stalk of the palm tree, v. <cite ref="L00270"><he>לוּלָב</he></cite>.—Pl. f. <he>לִבּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 7:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. VII</cite> <he>ממה שאתה בוחן ל׳ וכ׳</he> from the fact that thou examinest hearts and reins &c.—V. <cite ref="L00038"><he>לֵבָב</he></cite>.
senses.label: b
